name: code-factory
description: Route GitHub events into retained Codex conversations and configure them through confirmed chat proposals.

interface.shortDescription: GitHub issue and PR triage with local Codex agents
interface.longDescription: Chat with one retained Codex agent per pull request, route GitHub events through configurable rules, prioritize issues, and confirm configuration proposals. Conversations and worktrees remain on your computer. Connections use Tailscale HTTPS with owner-approved OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Continue the retained conversation for a pull request.
Open Code Factory’s GitHub issue and pull-request dashboard.
Show my agents that need attention.
Investigate an issue with a read-only Codex agent.
